**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Normalize state codes that precede ZIP codes**

When equivalent full addresses include a ZIP code, such as `100 Main Street, Austin, Texas 78701` and `100 Main St, Austin, TX 78701`, the state abbreviation is no longer the final token, so this condition leaves `TX` unexpanded and the site projection returns `UNKNOWN` or `CONFLICT`. The fresh canonicalizer therefore still loses an accepted site claim for a common address form; recognize a terminal state followed by an optional ZIP while retaining the ZIP in the comparison.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L6-L6](https://github.com/nrsandoval1231-oss/gl3/blob/db4568c49cc0a013472e8b3e110ae503d1b38d36/AGENTS.md#L6-L6)
